_comment: M14 P2 runaway_guard — protected process names. match = /proc/<pid>/comm exact OR startswith. No renice, no cpulimit, no kill. EVER.
_rule_ref: feedback_no_kill_claude_cli — claude CLI kill/STOP 절대 금지
_narrowed_2026_04_19: whitelist narrowed to 4 essential names only — claude/tailscaled/hexa/sshd. dbus-daemon/containerd/polkitd/node/systemd*/kworker* removed so fallback CAN target them when they are the real culprit. kernel threads (kthreadd/rcu_/ksoftirqd/migration/kswapd0) are PID-unreachable by renice/cpulimit anyway — removal is harmless.
